intro: Eswatini relies on sugar, soft-drink concentrate and trade with South Africa.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Sugar and soft-drink concentrate are the main exports. The currency is tied to the South African rand.

chapters.title: Health
text: Eswatini has had one of the world's highest HIV rates, now falling.

cardGroups.title: Made in Eswatini
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Eswatini makes and sells to the world.
